```{r}
KLD_divergence_without_zero_seg <- readRDS("KLD_divergence_without_zero_seg.rds")

kNN_divergence_without_zero_seg <- readRDS("kNN_divergence_without_zero_seg.rds")
```

#Calculation of ratios

##For the polynomial case

```{r}
kNN_ratio_without_zero <- list()

for (r in 1:3) {
  kNN_ratio_without_zero[[r]] <- divergnece_ratio(kNN_divergence_without_zero[[r]], KLD_divergence_without_zero[[r]])
}
```

```{r}
kNN_ratio_with_zero <- list()

for (r in 1:3) {
  kNN_ratio_with_zero[[r]] <- divergnece_ratio(kNN_divergence_with_zero[[r]], KLD_divergence_with_zero[[r]])
}
```

```{r}
kernel_ratio_without_zero <- list()

for (r in 1:3) {
  kernel_ratio_without_zero[[r]] <- divergnece_ratio(kernel_divergence_without_zero[[r]], KLD_divergence_without_zero[[r]])
}
```

```{r}
kernel_ratio_with_zero <- list()

for (r in 1:3) {
  kernel_ratio_with_zero[[r]] <- divergnece_ratio(kernel_divergence_with_zero[[r]], KLD_divergence_with_zero[[r]])
}
```

#For the piecewise function case

```{r}
kernel_ratio_with_zero_seg <- divergnece_ratio(kernel_divergence_with_zero_seg, KLD_divergence_with_zero_seg)

kernel_ratio_without_zero_seg <- divergnece_ratio(kernel_divergence_without_zero_seg, KLD_divergence_without_zero_seg)

kNN_ratio_with_zero_seg <- divergnece_ratio(kNN_divergence_with_zero_seg, KLD_divergence_with_zero_seg)

kNN_ratio_without_zero_seg <- divergnece_ratio(kNN_divergence_without_zero_seg, KLD_divergence_without_zero_seg)
```

#Visualization of Ratios

```{r}
picture_kernel_without_zero <- list()

for (p in 1:3) {
  type <- sprintf(" v = %d\n", p)
  picture_kernel_without_zero[[p]] <- plot_divergence_function(
  kernel_ratio_without_zero[[p]],
  type
)
}

picture_kernel_without_zero_seg <- plot_divergence_function(kernel_ratio_without_zero_seg,
  "Segmented"
)

kernel_without <- grid.arrange(picture_kernel_without_zero[[1]], picture_kernel_without_zero[[2]], picture_kernel_without_zero[[3]], picture_kernel_without_zero_seg,
             ncol = 4,
             #widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1),      # Largeurs égales
             #heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1),    # Hauteurs égales
             top = "Kernel regression"
             )

picture_kernel_with_zero <- list()

for (p in 1:3) {
  type <- sprintf(" v = %d \n", p)
  picture_kernel_with_zero[[p]] <- plot_divergence_function(
  kernel_ratio_with_zero[[p]],
  type
)
}

picture_kernel_with_zero_seg <- plot_divergence_function(kernel_ratio_with_zero_seg, "Segmented" )

kernel_with <- grid.arrange(picture_kernel_with_zero[[1]], picture_kernel_with_zero[[2]], picture_kernel_with_zero[[3]], picture_kernel_with_zero_seg,
             ncol = 4,
             #widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1),      # Largeurs égales
             #heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1),    # Hauteurs égales
             top = "Kernel regression"
             )

```

```{r}
             ncol = 4,
             #widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1),      # Largeurs égales

for (p in 1:3) {
```

```{r}
With_zero <- grid.arrange(kernel_with, kNN_with,
             ncol = 1,
             bottom = "With zero"
             )

ggsave("With_zero.jpg", plot = With_zero, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
Without_zero <- grid.arrange(kernel_without, kNN_without,
             ncol = 1,
             bottom = "Without zero"
             )

ggsave("Without_zero.jpg", plot = Without_zero, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
